top_signals.title: Dollar Wavers as CPI Adds to Fed Hike Bets While Oil Falls
top_signals.summary: The dollar oscillated Friday after a key gauge of US consumer prices rose by more than expected, pushing traders to add to bets that the Federal Reserve will raise interest rates next week.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.

top_signals.title: Iran, Russia condemn Western economic sanctions and urge BRICS bloc to deepen economic ties
top_signals.summary: Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian and Russian President Vladimir Putin criticized Western sanctions and asked the BRICS bloc to deepen trade ties.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Bill Dudley Expects Fed to Raise Rate by 25 Bps
top_signals.summary: Bill Dudley, a Bloomberg Opinion columnist and former president of the Federal Reserve Bank of New York, says he would be shocked if the Federal Reserve did not raise interest rates by 25 basis points at their next meeting. He speaks on "Bloomberg The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Microsoft Plugs Nearly 400 Security Holes
top_signals.summary: Microsoft today released updates to remedy at least 398 security vulnerabilities in its Windows operating systems and supported software, including one weakness that is already being actively exploited and two others that were publicly detailed prior to today.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
